params.name: id
params.description: The transaction ID of the pre-authorisation to capture

items.docs:
API to capture a previously pre-authorised transaction.

Usage notes:
  • The capture amount must be less than or equal to the original authorisation amount.
  • Only one capture is allowed per pre-authorised transaction. Once captured (fully or partially), the transaction cannot be captured again.

Access Token Required scope: captures/create
